//: lib: ["ES2021"] is the floor this package actually needs. WeakRef (Singleton.ts) lands in ES2021 (lib.es2021.weakref.d.ts); verified ES2020 fails on it with TS2304 'Cannot find name WeakRef'. Nothing here needs more, so no DOM and no types entries. NOTE: Singleton.ts previously carried its own `/// <reference lib="es2015.iterable" />` and `/// <reference lib="es2021.weakref" />` directives. Those were NOT redundant -- a triple-slash lib reference pulls the lib in regardless of this file, so the package compiled clean at lib: ["ES2015"] and this pin verified nothing. They are removed, which is what makes the floor above real and testable.
//exclude: *.spec.ts is the bun:test runtime suite -- excluded from this library program rather than pulled in with types: ["bun"], so @types/bun never re-loosens this package's ES2021 lib floor. bun test transpiles and runs it directly; nothing here type-checks it.
